proposalBoundary: Evaluate a bounded first-two-port cache as a follow-on to merged69558's intentional first-port cache. Never replace the most-recent value or add an unbounded/dictionary cache. If two-slot initialization requires compare-exchange to avoid duplicate/overwritten slots during a cold race,change only that tightly coupled startup seam.
requirements: Verify the current default helper,actual metrics/trace consumers,linked owning assemblies,history and existing work. Preserve unrelated current HTTP2 flow-control differences without claiming a full current-default server run.

Establish unchanged owner behavior and focused existing Kestrel metrics/SignalR activity tests before editing. Observe real MeterListener-produced queued start/stop values and integer endpoint tags;do not set private enabled flags or inject measurement callbacks.

Use actual in-tree Kestrel.Core and SignalR.Core helper copies;prepare bindings outside timing. Full queued-metrics rows call real CreateContext and RequestQueuedStart/Stop with a real enabled instrument. SignalR list-tag rows are helper measurements,not full hub invocation throughput.

Keep first-port,second-port,third/all-miss,two/four-port mixes,disabled instrumentation,IPv6,feature precedence/fallback and non-IP/null/multiplexed endpoint controls. Preserve complete ordered keys,typed values and protocol/transport data.

Warm caches through real producer calls,never field injection. Fresh child-process cold diagnostics must verify stable bounded cache state and two distinct ports after cold races. Include12-thread first/two-port/all-miss controls;record actual worker priorities/settings,per-worker allocations and operation units without assuming a main-thread memory diagnoser measures all worker bytes.

Freeze the same standalone harness/fixtures/settings and complete application images;only actual changed owner DLL/PDB may differ. Prove source/PDB document and loaded owner/hash/PID relationships without relabeling binaries as built from a later commit.

Before editing,fix absolute resource goals for second-port direct/tag/list and queued second/two-port targets. Every original row must fail for the expected allocation reason and every selected candidate row pass. Do not tune goals after seeing candidate data.

Keep steady-state first-port/all-miss/concurrent controls and startup/retained-state costs,even when unfavorable. One extra retained boxed integer per warmed participating owner is a cost,not free memory. No heap-size or cold-latency claim without matching evidence.

Serialize CPU-heavy work,max2 build nodes,activate the pinned SDK in every fresh dotnet shell,use only the settings-preserving emitted executor/Guid.Empty power and Normal priorities. No affinity/power/process tuning or unrelated process changes.

At most3 actual before/after comparisons;reverse pair order for comparison2. Stop early only for clear justified material gain;otherwise retain all variation,regressions and no-gain/rejected outcomes. Do not fabricate distinct source shapes.

Publish exact source,harness,fixtures,commands,raw outcomes,all attempts and portable/live audits. Only a compatible measured proposal gets a separate fork-only draft,using the actual template and immediate browser dispatch;otherwise publish honest disposition.
excludedClaims: No production-frequency,HTTP/application-wide or full SignalR invocation speedup from prepared component measurements.
No QUIC transport execution from a prepared MultiplexedConnectionContext control.
No public API/default/TFM/dependency changes,no shipping IVT or UnsafeAccessor,no unrelated code cleanup.
No proof of continuously idle or isolated execution,no rewritten BenchmarkDotNet Unknown processor metadata.
